free_tier.stated: Managed Agents is billed per open-platform API usage at the inference price of the named model (glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.3-flashx), with Coding Plan quota not supported. The sandbox and runtime environment are '限时免费至 2026 年 10 月 31 日' (free for a limited time until 2026-10-31), and Web Search / Web Fetch tool calls are '工具调用费用限时免费至 2026 年 10 月 31 日，之后按调用收费；模型 token 费用仍产生' (free until 2026-10-31, then charged per call, with model token fees still incurred). The platform drives the loop and emits session.status_idle when a round ends, Memory mounts into several sessions with audited changes, and cron creates new sessions on schedule.
